title: Extended logo and gradient-world loop
slide_intent: Repeat a recognizable reveal through changing environments so identity is learned through recurrence.
strategic_value: The green segmented 4 can remain the reference point while Channel 4’s gradient worlds vary.
demonstration: The 20-second clip repeatedly reveals and dissolves the green 4 while moving through pink, blue, yellow and dark rooms; the PNG preserves the published mid-assembly poster.
practical_value: Compare repeated reveal cycles to see what remains stable as the world changes.

content_islands.name: Logo cycles
content_islands.spec: Show the pieces resolving into the 4 and separating again.

content_islands.name: Changing room
content_islands.spec: Carry the mark through differently lit gradient environments before ending on the empty room.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip repeats the segmented-logo reveal within several gradient worlds.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram describes the singular logo and masterbrand color as anchors within varied content worlds.
